en.Windows сама удаляет временные файлы и с: Windows automatically deletes temporary files and old Recycle Bin content when the system drive runs low on space.
en.Предустановка Lycoris: запуск при нехват: Lycoris preset: runs when disk space is low, deletes temporary app files, empties Recycle Bin files older than 30 days. The Downloads folder is never cleaned automatically. If you have already configured Storage Sense, your values are kept — Lycoris only turns it on and fills in empty settings. Undo with the undo button or in Settings → System → Storage.
en.Контроль памяти отключён групповой полит: Storage Sense is turned off by a group policy.
en.Запрещает Windows самостоятельно загружа: Stops Windows from downloading promoted apps and games from Microsoft Store on its own.
en.Предотвращает будущие установки; уже уст: Prevents future installs; apps that are already installed are not removed — you can remove them in the “Apps” section. Less background traffic and disk load after major updates.
en.Если Windows переключена в режим «Оптими: If Windows is set to “Adjust for best performance of Background services”, gives priority back to foreground programs.
en.Параметр из Свойств системы → Быстродейс: A setting from System Properties → Performance → Advanced. On a normal system it is already correct and this item changes nothing. Lycoris does not apply the “gaming” Win32PrioritySeparation values from the internet (0x28, 0x2A, 0x16): their benefit is not proven. Takes effect immediately.
en.Программы из автозагрузки запускаются ср: Startup programs launch right after sign-in, without the artificial Windows pause.
en.Параметр не документирован Microsoft. На: This setting is not documented by Microsoft. It has no effect on games; on slow drives the desktop may respond worse right after sign-in while the programs start. Takes effect at the next sign-in.
en.Запрещает фоновую работу предустановленн: Blocks background activity for preinstalled apps: News, Weather, Clipchamp, Get Help, Solitaire.
en.Действует только на установленные прилож: Affects only installed apps from this list; Xbox, Game Bar and Windows Security are not touched. The gain is small — Windows already limits such apps — but they stop updating and sending notifications in the background. The apps work as usual when you open them.
None of the apps from the list are installed.
en.Политики Edge запрещают «ускорение запус: Edge policies turn off “startup boost” (Edge processes at Windows sign-in) and Edge running in the background after the last window is closed.
en.Официальные политики Microsoft StartupBo: Official Microsoft policies StartupBoostEnabled and BackgroundModeEnabled. Edge itself, its updates and WebView2 (widgets, Teams, game launchers) are not affected. The effect is modest and does not change FPS: Microsoft calls the load from startup boost limited and turns it on automatically only for people who open Edge often, while background mode is already off by default — the policy just locks that in. The cost: the first Edge launch after sign-in is slower, websites and installed web apps do not send notifications while Edge is closed, and in edge://settings/system these switches become unavailable with the note “Managed by your organization”. Undo removes the policies — Edge goes back to your settings.
en.Глобальный переключатель Windows 10: при: A global Windows 10 switch: Microsoft Store apps do not run in the background.
en.Касается только приложений Store; обычны: Affects only Store apps; regular programs (Steam, Discord, launchers) are not touched. Notifications and sync from such apps arrive only while they are open. Takes effect after signing out.
en.Только для Windows 10 — в Windows 11 это: Windows 10 only — this switch was removed in Windows 11.
en.Центр обновления не будет перезагружать: Windows Update will not restart the computer from 8:00 AM to 2:00 AM.
en.Отключает автоматический подбор периода: Turns off automatic active hours and sets the maximum allowed interval — 18 hours. Updates are still downloaded and installed; the restart is moved to the night. You can change the time in Settings → Windows Update → Advanced options. Game Mode already prevents restarts during a game.
en.Ежегодные обновления функций (например,: Yearly feature updates (for example, 24H2 → 25H2) arrive 90 days after release; security updates come as usual.
en.За это время Microsoft и производители д: In that time Microsoft and driver vendors fix problems in the new version, including with games and anti-cheats. A Windows Update policy is used, so Settings will show “Some settings are managed by your organization”. Works on Pro and higher editions. Chosen instead of “Stay on the current Windows 11 version” — if that one is already applied, undo it first.
en.Windows Home не поддерживает отсрочку об: Windows Home does not support deferring updates.
en.Ежемесячные обновления безопасности прих: Monthly security updates arrive as usual, while the yearly feature update waits until you clear this item.
en.Только для Pro и старших редакций и для: Only for Pro and higher editions and for released Windows 11 versions with a known end-of-support date that has not passed yet.
en.Не ставить драйверы через Центр обновлен: Do not install drivers through Windows Update
en.Центр обновления перестаёт устанавливать: Windows Update stops installing drivers along with the monthly updates.
en.Полезно, если Windows Update заменяет ус: Useful if Windows Update replaces the graphics driver you installed with an older one. Windows's own updates keep arriving. Update drivers manually — in the “Drivers” section of Lycoris or on the vendor's website.
en.Windows перестанет сама ставить любые др: Windows will stop installing any drivers on its own, including useful ones (chipset, Wi-Fi, printers, security fixes). You will have to keep track of drivers yourself.
en.Если TRIM (уведомления об удалении) для: If someone turned off TRIM (delete notifications) for NTFS, turns it back on: the SSD learns about freed blocks again.
en.TRIM в Windows включён по умолчанию; его: TRIM is on by default in Windows; third-party “optimizers” often turn it off. Without it an SSD writes data more slowly over time. On a healthy system this item changes nothing. Only the NTFS setting is changed (DisableDeleteNotification = 0, the same as “fsutil behavior set DisableDeleteNotify 0”); the ReFS setting, including for Dev Drive, is not touched by Lycoris — Microsoft turns TRIM off there on purpose. Microsoft notes that on some drives performance drops with TRIM: if you turned it off for that reason, undo this item — the previous value comes back. If TRIM is set by a group policy, the item is not offered. No restart needed.
en.SSD не найден, либо TRIM задан групповой: No SSD found, or TRIM is set by a group policy.
en.Если стандартную задачу «Оптимизация дис: If the standard scheduled “Optimize Drives” task was turned off, turns it back on.
en.Это задача Windows \\Microsoft\\Windows\: This is the Windows task \Microsoft\Windows\Defrag\ScheduledDefrag, on by default: on a schedule (usually weekly) Windows optimizes the drives — HDDs are defragmented, while SSDs get a repeated TRIM once a month and, per Microsoft's rules, regular defragmentation when needed (most often with restore points enabled) — this is how Windows is designed. Some “optimizers” turn the task off, but the schedule can also be turned off normally in the “Optimize Drives” window, so this item is not part of any profile — turn it on if it was not you who turned it off. On a healthy system this item changes nothing. Undo restores the previous state of the task.
en.Задачи «Оптимизация дисков» нет в этой с: The “Optimize Drives” task does not exist on this system.
en.Не обновлять время последнего доступа: Do not update last access time
en.NTFS перестаёт записывать время последне: NTFS stops recording the last time files were opened (like fsutil behavior set disablelastaccess 1).
en.На SSD/NVMe выигрыш ничтожный: NTFS и та: On SSD/NVMe the gain is negligible: NTFS already updates this time in batches, no more than once an hour. The original value of the setting is saved and restored on undo. A restart is needed.
en.Программы резервного копирования, удалён: Backup, remote storage and “long unopened” file cleanup programs may work incorrectly. There is practically no speedup on an SSD.
en.Возвращает стандартную настройку «Автома: Restores the default “Automatically manage paging file size for all drives” setting.
en.Исправление после «оптимизаторов», котор: A fix after “optimizers” that shrank or turned off the page file. It sets the limit of allocatable memory: without it games and browsers crash with an out-of-memory error even when RAM is free, and crash dumps are not saved. If you deliberately moved the page file to another drive, you do not need this item. The previous configuration is remembered for undo. A restart is needed.
en.Не индексировать файлы от батареи: Do not index files on battery
en.Служба поиска Windows приостанавливает и: Windows Search pauses indexing while the laptop runs on battery.
en.Немного продлевает работу от батареи; пр: Slightly extends battery life; indexing continues when plugged in. Uses an official Windows Search policy.
en.Отключает «Целостность памяти» (Безопасн: Turns off “Memory integrity” (Windows Security → Device security → Core isolation).
en.Microsoft признаёт, что целостность памя: Microsoft acknowledges that Memory integrity can reduce gaming performance “in some scenarios”: in tests the loss is 0–10%, about 5% on average, less on newer processors. Virtualization itself (VBS) is not turned off. You can turn it back on with undo or with the switch in Windows Security. A restart is needed.
en.Снижает защиту ядра от эксплойтов и откл: Reduces kernel protection against exploits and turns off the blocking of vulnerable drivers. Some anti-cheats (Riot Vanguard, FACEIT) require Memory integrity to be on — such games may stop launching. Turn it off only if you understand the risk.
en.Целостность памяти заблокирована в UEFI: Memory integrity is locked in UEFI or managed by a policy.
